reason: Node 1.1.3 has no definitions, dependencies, assumptions, or externals in scope, yet it asserts the nontrivial bridge from a modern C^1 manifold/atlas to Cairns-Veblen-Whitehead 'class one' and 'allowable coordinate systems.' The sole workspace external merely states a theorem conditional on those historical notions; it does not define or prove this identification, and Cairns lines 45-46 expressly say allowability is determined by separate axioms. Therefore 'by_definition' is unsupported: an arbitrary C^1 atlas chart has not been shown to satisfy those allowability axioms, so its domains cannot be concluded to be precisely allowable-coordinate domains.
